claims.label: Trial of 22 defendants in France centered on Athanor Masonic lodge
claims.claim: A Guardian article reports that 22 people are on trial in France on charges of murder and other serious crimes centered on a Masonic lodge (the Athanor lodge) in the Paris suburb of Puteaux.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via the original Guardian article and French court records.

claims.label: Lodge accused of running hit squads
claims.claim: Per a Guardian article the host reads aloud, prosecutors allege the Athanor lodge group carried out murder, attempted murder, aggravated assault, and criminal conspiracy on behalf of a mafia network inside the lodge.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify prosecutor filings in the French trial.

claims.label: Per Article Host Reads, Four DGSE Officers Among Defendants
claims.claim: Per a Guardian article the host reads aloud, four officers from France's DGSE foreign intelligence service are among the 22 defendants.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with French court documents.

claims.label: Per Article Host Reads, Failed July 2020 Contract Killing Targeted Marie-Hélène Dini
claims.claim: Per a Guardian article the host reads aloud, the case was triggered by a failed contract killing in July 2020, when two members of France's parachute regiment were arrested in possession of weapons near the home of business coach Marie-Hélène Dini.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify date and circumstances of arrest via French press archives.

claims.label: Hitmen claimed to be acting on behalf of the French state
claims.claim: Per a Guardian article the host reads aloud, the hitmen told investigators they believed they had been asked to murder Dini on behalf of the French state.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify investigator statements in court filings.

claims.label: Hitmen stated Dini worked for Mossad
claims.claim: Per a Guardian article the host reads aloud, the hitmen stated they were targeting Dini on the grounds that she worked for the Israeli spy agency, the Mossad.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether this allegation appears in formal charges or witness statements.

claims.label: Jean-Luc Bagur, Frédéric Vaglio, and Daniel Beaulieu Identified as Principal Conspirators
claims.claim: The host says Jean-Luc Bagur was a ringleader of the alleged conspiracy, alongside fellow Freemasons Frédéric Vaglio and Daniel Beaulieu.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify role assignments via French court documents.

claims.label: Daniel Beaulieu Attempted Suicide in Prison
claims.claim: The host says Daniel Beaulieu, a retired intelligence officer, had an apparent suicide attempt while in prison, and that he is now impaired and will not be able to testify.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify incident via French press reporting or court records.

claims.label: Erika Kirk affirmed belief that Tyler Robinson murdered Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays of an interview with Bari Weiss, Erika Kirk says "Yes, I do" in response to the question of whether she believes Tyler Robinson murdered her husband.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check with the published version of the Bari Weiss interview.

claims.label: Erika Kirk claimed to have seen the autopsy report
claims.claim: Erika Kirk stated she had seen the autopsy report and had been in constant contact with her lawyers and the prosecuting team.
claims.investigative_direction: Determine whether such access is procedurally consistent with case status.

claims.label: Frank Turek described Erika being told of Charlie's death
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Frank Turek says they were all standing in the hall when a doctor came out and said Charlie Kirk was dead, and that he then said "I need to talk to Erika."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against other witness accounts of the moment.

claims.label: Stacy Sheridan and Katherine Locastro identified as with Erika
claims.claim: Frank Turek stated that Stacy Sheridan and Katherine Locastro were with Erika Kirk when she was informed of Charlie Kirk's death.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against other contemporaneous accounts.

claims.label: Frank Turek stated Mikey arranged to retrieve Erika
claims.claim: Frank Turek stated Mikey was on the phone arranging a plane to retrieve Erika.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check with other accounts of plane arrangements.

claims.label: Candace Owens' November tweet asserted French Legion training and multi-state involvement
claims.claim: In a November tweet the host shows, Candace Owens stated she had a source inside the French government who told her the French intervention group was involved in the assassination, and that Charlie Kirk's assassin trained with the French Legion 13th Brigade with multi-state involvement.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original tweet and any subsequent corroboration or denial.

claims.label: Governor Cox stated family member contacted family friend
claims.claim: Governor Cox stated that on the evening of September 11th, a family member of Tyler Robinson reached out to a family friend.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with Brooksby's account.

claims.label: Governor Cox stated family friend contacted Washington County Sheriff's Office
claims.claim: Governor Cox stated the family friend contacted the Washington County Sheriff's Office with information about Robinson.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with Brooksby's account.

claims.label: Governor Cox stated Robinson "confessed or implied"
claims.claim: Governor Cox stated that Robinson had "confessed to them or implied that he had committed the incident."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify whether any signed confession statement exists; reconcile with Brooksby's account which contains no such claim.

claims.label: Brooksby received call from retired detective friend at 8:02 PM
claims.claim: Sheriff Brooksby stated that at 8:02 PM on September 11th he received a call from a friend who was a retired detective; court documents refer to this individual as a "retired Washington County deputy."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the individual via court filings.

claims.label: Brooksby told Robinson had suicidal ideations
claims.claim: Sheriff Brooksby stated he was told that Tyler Robinson had potential suicidal ideations and was en route to a remote area in Washington County.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against other sources.

claims.label: Robinson's parents convinced him not to go to remote area
claims.claim: Sheriff Brooksby stated Robinson's parents convinced him not to go to the remote area and conveyed they would help him surrender peacefully.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with subsequent reporting.

claims.label: Friend drove Robinson and parents to Sheriff's office
claims.claim: Sheriff Brooksby stated that within the hour, his friend drove Tyler Robinson and his parents to Brooksby's office, where Robinson was greeted by plainclothes detectives.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against court records and other accounts.

claims.label: Brooksby stated Robinson feared SWAT team or being shot
claims.claim: Sheriff Brooksby stated Tyler Robinson was fearful of a SWAT team hit on his house and fearful of being shot by law enforcement, which was part of the negotiation to bring him in.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with Cox's framing of an outright confession (C-7656).

claims.label: Erika Kirk was on plane when Charlie was pronounced dead
claims.claim: A New York Times article reports that Mr. Kirk's chartered plane traveled back to Scottsdale to ferry his wife to Provo, and that he was pronounced dead as she was airborne.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against other reporting on timing.

claims.label: Erika Kirk described the day as "gorgeous"
claims.claim: Erika Kirk told the New York Times that during the flight she was looking at "the clouds and the mountains," called the day "gorgeous," and stated she was thinking it was "exactly what he last saw."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference against other contemporaneous accounts of Erika's statements.

claims.label: Host Says Sheriff Brooksby Resigned from Washington County Sheriff's Office
claims.claim: The host says Sheriff Nate Brooksby resigned from the Washington County Sheriff's Office.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain official Washington County Commission statement and any press release explaining the resignation.

claims.label: Brooksby resignation occurred on a Friday
claims.claim: The host states Brooksby's resignation occurred on a Friday and that no public statement was given.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm exact date via Commission records.

claims.label: Host Says Commission Statement Noted Brooksby Served 30+ Years in Law Enforcement
claims.claim: The host says a statement released by the Washington County Commission noted that Sheriff Brooksby had served in law enforcement for more than 30 years.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Commission statement.

claims.label: Host Says Brooksby's Name Was Removed from Sheriff's Office Website
claims.claim: The host says that over the weekend following the resignation, Brooksby's name was quietly removed from the Sheriff's Office website and social media pages.
claims.investigative_direction: Capture archived versions of the website and social pages.

claims.label: Host Says She Told Listeners in November That France and the DGSE Were Involved
claims.claim: The host says that back in November she told listeners France was involved in Charlie Kirk's assassination, specifically its intelligence agency, the DGSE.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the November 2025 posts and episodes where the host first made the DGSE claim and compare the wording with this restatement; ask French authorities whether DGSE personnel were abroad on September 10, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: back in November, I was telling you guys that France was in fact involved in Charlie Kirk's assassination, specifically that their intelligence agency, also known as DGSE, was involved.

claims.label: Host Says the 33 References Were Freemasonry Signaling
claims.claim: The host says the whole '33' theme around the assassination was not subtle and was Freemasonry, and that she had said so earlier.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify every official or TPUSA figure who used the number 33 publicly and when; compare to ordinary coincidence rates (33 hours of manhunt, date and time counts).
claims.transcript_snippet: And that the whole 33 thing was not subtle, it was Freemasonry.

claims.label: Host Says America Was Founded by Warring Factions of Freemasons Seeking a New Atlantis
claims.claim: The host says America was founded by warring factions of Freemasons who pursued the country in the hope of establishing a new Atlantis removed from their battles with the Catholic Empire.
claims.investigative_direction: Check standard histories of Freemasonry in the American colonies; the claim about a 'new Atlantis' motive is the host's reading and needs a named source.
claims.transcript_snippet: America was in fact founded by warring factions of Freemasons. Freemasons pursued America in the hopes of establishing a a new Atlantis

claims.label: Clip Played: Speaker Says a Message Came About 33 Minutes Before Kirk Was Killed
claims.claim: In a clip montage the host plays, one speaker says something happened about 33 minutes before Charlie Kirk was killed, and a speaker says Kirk was assassinated at UVU and about a 33-hour manhunt followed.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the speaker and source of the clip (press conference or interview) and the full sentence about the 33 minutes; the transcript does not name the speaker.
claims.transcript_snippet: And that was about uh I think I had it it was like 33 minutes before he was killed.

claims.label: Clip Played: Speaker Says 33 Hours of Progress for Charlie
claims.claim: In the clip the host plays, a speaker says that in 33 hours they made historic progress for Charlie, and another says for 33 hours he was praying that if this had to happen here it would not be one of us.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the speakers in the clip; compare with Kash Patel and Governor Cox press-conference transcripts for the 33-hour phrasing.
claims.transcript_snippet: In 33 hours, we have made historic progress for Charlie.

claims.label: Host Says the St. George Utah Masonic Lodge Is Number 33
claims.claim: The host says that of all Freemason lodges, which each carry a number, the one in St. George, Utah, where Tyler Robinson was brought in, is lodge number 33.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Grand Lodge of Utah's list of lodges for the St. George lodge number and location; confirm that Robinson was taken to St. George (the Washington County Sheriff's Office).
claims.transcript_snippet: the one that is in St. George, Utah, which is where Tyler Robinson was brought in, is lodge number 33, okay?

claims.label: Host Says 33 Is the Country Code for Paris
claims.claim: The host says 33 is also the country code for Paris.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify with the ITU country-code list: +33 is France's calling code (not specific to Paris); the claim is checkable but its link to the case is the host's inference.
claims.transcript_snippet: 33 also being the country code for Paris.

claims.label: Host Says Scottish Rite Freemasonry Originated in France After the Templars
claims.claim: The host says Scottish Rite Freemasonry originated in France, after Jacques de Molay was hanged or burned at the stake and the Pope dissolved the group over accusations of Baal worship and sexual rites, and that members then left for Scotland.
claims.investigative_direction: Consult historians of Freemasonry on the origin of the Scottish Rite; the host ties the Templars to Freemasonry, which mainstream scholarship treats as a legend rather than a lineage.
claims.transcript_snippet: the Scottish Rite Freemasonry actually originated in France, okay?

claims.label: Host Says the Article Reports French Foreign Legion Involvement
claims.claim: The host says the article reports that the French Foreign Legion and the military were involved in murder for hire, although the passage she has just read mentions soldiers and DGSE officers but not the Foreign Legion, and the next passage names a parachute regiment.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against the Guardian article text: it names the parachute regiment and DGSE officers; check whether any defendant is a Foreign Legion member.
claims.transcript_snippet: They're saying the French Foreign Legion and the military was involved in murder for hire?

claims.label: Host Says Parachute Regiment Members Wear Maroon Shirts in Plain Clothes
claims.claim: The host says French parachute regiment members wear maroon berets and, when in plain clothes, wear maroon shirts, and that people can verify this online.
claims.investigative_direction: Find a source for plain-clothes maroon shirts among French paratroopers; compare with the maroon-shirt witnesses at UVU, who have not been tied to French units.
claims.transcript_snippet: And when they're in plain clothes, they wear maroon shirts.

claims.label: Host Says She Sent Material to the FBI and White House That the French Were on the Ground
claims.claim: The host says she sent something to the FBI and to the White House and told listeners it was real and that French forces were on the ground that day.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host for the date, recipients and content of the FBI and White House submissions; check FBI tip-line and FOIA records.
claims.transcript_snippet: I I sent something to the FBI, I sent it to the White House. I told you this was real and that they were on the ground that day.

claims.label: Host Says There Is a Persistent Rumor That Brigitte Macron Is Mossad
claims.claim: The host says there is a persistent rumor that Brigitte Macron is actually Mossad, and that this came from a tip she cannot state as definitive.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host to identify the tip source; no public record in this episode supports the rumor, and Macron's office has denied related claims.
claims.transcript_snippet: there is this persistent rumor that Brigitte Macron is actually Mossad.

claims.label: Host Relays Tip That Brigitte Macron's Family Worked for Israel Over an Old Favor
claims.claim: The host relays a tip alleging that Brigitte Macron's family, allegedly from Germany, had worked on behalf of the Nazis, that it became a big story in the 1950s which the Israeli government cleaned up, and that the family has worked for Israel since.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek the tipster and any documentary basis (1950s press coverage, archives); the host presents it as an allegation she cannot confirm.
claims.transcript_snippet: they had alleged that Brigitte's family was working on behalf of Israel for a very long time because they owed Israel a very big favor

claims.label: Host Says Hitmen Say Daniel Beaulieu Told Them It Was on Behalf of the Government
claims.claim: The host says the hitmen say that Daniel Beaulieu, a retired intelligence officer, told them they were carrying out the killing on behalf of the government.
claims.investigative_direction: Check French court reporting for the hitmen's statements naming Balou as the source of the government claim.
claims.transcript_snippet: the hitmen say that Daniel is the one that told them that they were doing this on behalf of the government.

claims.label: Host Says the Freemason Mafia Carried Out Other Killings, Robberies and Assaults
claims.claim: The host says the story reports that the Freemason mafia carried out other killings, robberies and assaults to protect its members and business associates over the years.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Guardian/AP text for the other crimes attributed to the Athanor group and the charges actually brought.
claims.transcript_snippet: The Freemason mafia, as the story will tell you, has carried out other killings, robberies, assaults to protect them and their business associates over the year.

claims.label: Host Says Kushner and the Trumps Are Planning Gaza Real Estate
claims.claim: The host says Jared Kushner and the Trumps are planning to turn Gaza into a real estate empire.
claims.investigative_direction: Review public Gaza reconstruction plans attributed to Kushner or the administration, and Kushner's 2024 Harvard remarks.
claims.transcript_snippet: say you're going to turn it into a real estate emperor uh empire uh like Jared Kushner and the Trumps are planning for Gaza.

claims.label: Host Says Kirk Stepped on the Toes of Netanyahu and the War-for-Profit Machine in June
claims.claim: The host says that in June of last year Charlie Kirk stepped on the toes of Benjamin Netanyahu and the CIA's war-for-profit machine.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with documented Kirk statements against an Iran war in June 2025 and the June 18 White House meeting.
claims.transcript_snippet: My friend Charlie Kirk stepped on the toes of Bibi Netanyahu and the CIA's war for profit machine.

claims.label: Host Says Everyone Involved on September 10 Has a Military Connection
claims.claim: The host says everyone involved on September 10 has a military connection, naming Frank Turek, the McCoys and naval intelligence.
